description: This file defines a base activity class for Android applications, providing common logging setup and lifecycle handling by extending FragmentActivity.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base activity class that handles logging and common setup for Android sample activities, extending FragmentActivity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created; currently calls the superclass implementation.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity becomes visible; calls initializeLogging to set up logging.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain by wrapping Android's Log with a custom LogWrapper and logs a 'Ready' message.
